item.title: Netanyahu leans on Trump ties as Israel heads toward elections
item.description: Only one image was released from Donald Trump and Benjamin Netanyahu’s meeting Wednesday: a handshake in the Oval Office, distributed by the Israeli Prime Minister’s Office. Beyond that single frame, there were no reporters, no statements, no spontaneous gaggle with shouted questions.

item.title: Failure to yield leads to crash at S.R. 19 and C.R. 30, one sent to hospital
item.description: ELKHART COUNTY, Ind. -- The Elkhart County Sheriff's Office reports deputies responded to the intersection of S.R. 19 and C.R. 30 around 1:09 p.m., Thursday, for a two-vehicle crash.

item.title: The Cost of Power: ABC57 digs into rising utility bills causing regional outrage
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- ABC57’s Blake Parker spent weeks digging into the rising cost of utility bills across Northern Indiana, after rapid social media outrage with hundreds of posts, and protests directed at the Northern Indiana Public Service Company (NIPSCO) amassed across the region.

item.title: COURT DOCS: Elkhart teacher describes meetup with teen as 'Grindr hookup'
item.description: ELKHART COUNTY, Ind. -- An Elkhart teacher is facing multiple preliminary charges including Child Seduction after being arrested on Wednesday.

item.title: Congressman Tim Walberg speaks with ABC57 on a number of major news topics
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- ABC57 spoke with Michigan 5th District Congressman Tim Walberg today about several issues making headlines; from the ICE surge coming to an end in Minneapolis, to the new voter identification bill approved by the House and the Trump administration's repeal of a 2009 EPA decision called the "endangerment finding" being repealed and its potential impacts on air quality and efforts to fight climate change.

item.title: Probable cause affidavit shares disturbing details in sexual misconduct case of Elkhart teacher Donald Shafer
item.description: GOSHEN, Ind. — ABC 57 News has obtained a probable cause affidavit that details what took place in the early hours on Wednesday morning with Elkhart teacher, Donald Shafer, and a teenage boy.

item.title: Memorial walk for Elkhart teen killed in police involved shooting
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- An emotional day in Elkhart as friends and family of 17-year-old Bryan Ramirez Gomez organized a silent walk as they continue to demand accountability from local law enforcement. Ramirez Gomez was shot and killed by police officers early Sunday morning in Elkhart.

item.title: Marshall County Humane Society's cats look forward to celebrating Valentine's Day
item.description: MARSHALL COUNTY, Ind. -- The Marshall County Humane Society's kitties are looking forward to celebrating Valentine's Day-- in their own special way.

item.title: Liberty Township holds meeting for community members to voice concerns regarding fire territory merger
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. -- The Liberty Township Volunteer Fire Department held a community meeting Thursday evening to allow residents of both North Liberty and Center Township to voice their concerns regarding the upcoming integration of Center Township and Greene Township Fire into Liberty Greene Fire Territory.
